_why: (#2265 review) The create_mod WIRE SHAPE, checked in once and used by BOTH sides of the runtime->host boundary. The runtime's test asserts the value it PRODUCES equals `emitted` here; the host's test feeds `emitted` here to its reader and asserts the record it writes. Two hand-written fixtures on either side of a boundary is exactly how the first version's attachment-shape break hid: the runtime emitted the model's path STRINGS while the host read `{path, bytes}` objects, and every test agreed with its own side. Change this file and both tests move together, or one of them fails.
